claimedCapabilities.name: F0 - Contract Freeze
claimedCapabilities.gate: Every user-visible control maps to a command, query, event, or explicit unsupported state. UI cannot invent truth.

claimedCapabilities.name: C1 - Ledger And Projections
claimedCapabilities.gate: Projections rebuild from scratch after daemon restart. Duplicate events are idempotent. Unknown schema fields are tolerated.

claimedCapabilities.name: C2 - Adapters And Compliance Probes
claimedCapabilities.gate: One compliant body, one weak body, one observed body, and one malicious fixture all display different, accurate states.

claimedCapabilities.name: C3 - Operator Control Panel
claimedCapabilities.gate: No ordinary operator action requires typing an id. Screenshot, GIF, and recording show live and historical states.

claimedCapabilities.name: C5 - Governance And Tool Gates
claimedCapabilities.gate: Destructive git fixture has no side effect, and denial appears in transcript and Work Receipt.

claimedCapabilities.name: C8 - Setup And Doctor
claimedCapabilities.gate: Broken hook, missing provider key, disabled MCP, and stale daemon fixtures all produce repair cards and retest.

claimedCapabilities.name: C4/C6/C7 - Memory, Skills, And Cooperation
claimedCapabilities.gate: A context-pressure fixture creates a cited compaction packet, a missing skill produces remediation, and two overlapping agents trigger visible conflict handling.

claimedCapabilities.name: Priority Program - Postmaster And Plan-First Continuity
claimedCapabilities.gate: Crash, compaction, takeover, new-review, merged-PR, and overlapping-work fixtures each produce one bounded, idempotent next action backed by durable plan, cursor, packet, or settlement evidence.

claimedCapabilities.name: Later - Harbor Editor, Mobile, Cloud, Teams
claimedCapabilities.gate: Local-only mode proves no upload. Cloud mode proves explicit pairing, encryption, budget, and delete/export.

F0. Contract freeze chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: No other chain may make breaking event/API assumptions until F0 marks v0 as provisional. Additive fields are allowed; removals or renames require a versioned transform.

claimedCapabilities.name: C1. Event ledger, database, and projections chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - events are immutable, past-tense, and schema-versioned; - projections rebuild from scratch; - consumers are idempotent; - API v0 tolerates unknown fields; - cache entries have TTL, invalidation owner, and staleness label.

claimedCapabilities.name: C1. Event ledger, database, and projections chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before destructive migrations, dropping legacy columns, or changing public API response shapes.

claimedCapabilities.name: C2. Adapter, LLM router, and compliance probe chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - forged compliance fixture is downgraded; - partial cost is captured on abort/failure; - model tier is shown separately from provider-specific model name; - a C0/C1 observed body never receives C2+ controls; - old adapter versions get sunset warnings instead of silent breakage.

claimedCapabilities.name: C2. Adapter, LLM router, and compliance probe chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before enabling a new adapter to run shell, GitHub, deploy, or broad filesystem tools.

claimedCapabilities.name: C3. Operator control panel chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - no raw ID typing for ordinary use; - live stream and saved transcript are distinct and visible; - every action button has enabled, disabled, pending, failed, and acknowledged states; - pane failure does not blank the workspace; - human approval gates show context, cost, confidence, and what happens next.

claimedCapabilities.name: C3. Operator control panel chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before any irreversible action button: deploy, post externally, force interrupt remote execution, delete, retire, or publish.

claimedCapabilities.name: C4. Context, memory, search, and argumentative lineage chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - all local transcripts are saved by default; - injection is budgeted and source-linked; - no recursive summary from prior summary without source zoom; - every synthesized claim can show lineage or be marked unsupported; - retrieval@5, citation precision, P95 latency, and hallucination rate are reported before memory is used for successor resume.

claimedCapabilities.name: C4. Context, memory, search, and argumentative lineage chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before using transcript-derived data for public skills, training data, cloud sync, or externally visible claims.

claimedCapabilities.name: C5. Governance, security, and human gate chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - every high-risk action has a structural, economic, social, or accepted-risk defense classification; - economic defenses have numbers; - social defenses include a bootstrap failure plan; - approval gates are not placed after every node; - autonomy claims include refusal, delay, and local interpretation semantics.

claimedCapabilities.name: C5. Governance, security, and human gate chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before irreversible actions, user-facing external output, high-cost phases, low-confidence outputs, and first run of new automation templates.

claimedCapabilities.name: C6. Cooperative IDE and Harbor Editor chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - agents are peers, not invisible tools; - CRDT byte merge never replaces intent governance; - dead-replica op log can be replayed; - daemon remains the collaboration server for the first slice; - transport abstraction exists, but LAN/remote transport is not built before local buffer plus governance.

claimedCapabilities.name: C6. Cooperative IDE and Harbor Editor chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before merging agent-authored edits across contested claims or publishing collaborative edits externally.

claimedCapabilities.name: C7. Evaluation, simulation, and scheduling chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - every metric has confidence interval; - comparisons include effect size; - human ratings have kappa; - at least one Tier A baseline exists; - bottleneck resources are identified before scheduler commitments; - output is behavioral envelope, not one brittle nominal sequence.

claimedCapabilities.name: C7. Evaluation, simulation, and scheduling chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before publishing benchmark claims, ROI claims, or marketing charts.

claimedCapabilities.name: C8. Setup, doctor, adoption, and docs chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - default install path is one command or signed app flow; - `pd doctor` has one repair path per detected issue where possible; - no stale npm instructions; - hook metadata is transparent; - users can see local-only versus cloud-sync state.

claimedCapabilities.name: C8. Setup, doctor, adoption, and docs chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before changing installer behavior, update channel, privacy copy, or any flow that stores keys or uploads data.

claimedCapabilities.name: C9. Background Longshoremen chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: - visible suggestions capped and batched; - background work has explicit budget and stop reason; - Longshoremen cannot silently mutate code or publish externally; - every claim of contradiction has source lineage; - dead Longshoremen are salvageable like Voyagers.

claimedCapabilities.name: C9. Background Longshoremen chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: Required before a Longshoreman changes files, comments on GitHub, sends messages externally, spends above threshold, or modifies a shared skill.

claimedCapabilities.name: C10. Observability and zero-trust chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: No team/cloud/public harbor without C10.

claimedCapabilities.name: C11. MCP and media platform chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: No marketing claim that Port Daddy can build apps end-to-end until C11 can show running software, console errors, screenshots, and artifacts.

claimedCapabilities.name: C12. Sonic identity chain
claimedCapabilities.gate: No cue ships without visual counterpart, mute/DND compliance, and off-thread playback.

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Intake And Node Shaping (chapter-level claim, no acceptance gate in text)
C1. The compliance ladder can still become theater
claimedCapabilities.gate: No compliance badge ships without a matching "prove it fails" test.

claimedCapabilities.name: C2. Same-UID host safety is detection, not containment
claimedCapabilities.gate: `pd doctor` and `pd-console` must show "observed only" for read-only sensors. Real prevention requires Santa, Network Extension, Endpoint Security, pf, a separate UID, container, or VM boundary.

claimedCapabilities.name: C3. Capability leases are not cryptographic enough yet
claimedCapabilities.gate: A guarded resource must reject an expired, replayed, wrong-audience, wrong-body, parent-scope-widening, or lower-fencing-token lease even if the agent claims approval.

claimedCapabilities.name: C4. Federation language is ahead of federation proofs
claimedCapabilities.gate: Team/public harbor milestones require a threat model table with trust, tokens, revocation, Sybil, settlement, equivocation, bond drain, cold start, and operator-Sybil rows.

claimedCapabilities.name: C5. Federated revocation has to fail closed under partition
claimedCapabilities.gate: Before team/public harbors, a TLA+/Apalache model or equivalent test fixture must show: after `revoked(token, epoch) + D`, no non-partitioned harbor accepts the token; partitioned harbors enter `refuse_cross_harbor` until resync.

claimedCapabilities.name: C6. Transcript-by-default needs a tested redaction boundary
claimedCapabilities.gate: Milestone 1 needs fixtures for provider keys, SSH keys, `.env` paths, OAuth tokens, npmrc, Docker auth, shell history, and MCP config. Raw secret values must not persist unless the user explicitly enables encrypted raw retention.

claimedCapabilities.name: C7. Work Plan launch is a saga, not a function call
claimedCapabilities.gate: The daemon must tolerate duplicate create requests, process launch failure, transcript writer failure, billing abort, stale capability lease, and app disconnect without corrupting state.

claimedCapabilities.name: C8. Work Receipts can become self-certifying theater
claimedCapabilities.gate: A receipt cannot promote a claim to "verified" unless the relevant oracle entry says how the claim can be replayed or challenged.

claimedCapabilities.name: C9. Operator appeal still depends on proof, not breadth
claimedCapabilities.gate: Marketing, install, and app onboarding should show live transcript, file changes, blocked dangerous command, and resume/receipt. Do not lead with a taxonomy of harbors, staff, bonds, or adapters.

claimedCapabilities.name: C10. First value must be three moments, not ten
claimedCapabilities.gate: The native app onboarding should pass this flow before any team, marketplace, cloud vault, or public harbor language appears.

claimedCapabilities.name: C11. Desktop layout needs a geometry contract
claimedCapabilities.gate: `pd-console` visual PRs need screenshots and recordings at 1280x720, 1440x900, laptop high-density, and narrow snapped width. No critical action may live only in a bottom bar.

claimedCapabilities.name: C12. Surface routing must be explicit
claimedCapabilities.gate: A new surface can add a capability only if it names its routing role and the canonical API/read model it uses.

claimedCapabilities.name: C13. Skill grafting can become invisible prompt mutation
claimedCapabilities.gate: No skill graft reaches an official Agent Node without a transcript event and a UI-visible "why this was injected" detail.

claimedCapabilities.name: C14. Event sourcing without ordering semantics is a trap
claimedCapabilities.gate: Every read model in the app must say whether it is live, replaying, stale, or partial. Projection rebuild from the event log is a release gate.

claimedCapabilities.name: C15. Consistency guarantees must be explicit
claimedCapabilities.gate: Every API response that can be stale carries a projection offset, freshness timestamp, and staleness label.

claimedCapabilities.name: C16. Public/team harbors need legibility scopes
claimedCapabilities.gate: Every event kind, claim, transcript, receipt, skill, and blackboard item has a visibility scope and sharing policy before team/public harbors ship.

claimedCapabilities.name: C17. Device recovery can silently become the weakest control path
claimedCapabilities.gate: Mobile control cannot ship until stolen-device, replayed-command, expired approval, and revoked-device fixtures all fail closed.

claimedCapabilities.gate: - every user action maps to command, query, or event; - UI cannot fabricate runtime truth; - transcript, control, cost, claim, and receipt events are append-only; - restart/reconnect can rebuild visible state from backend truth; - old verbs are intake metadata, not runtime concepts.

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Order C1 - Event ledger and projections
claimedCapabilities.gate: - projections rebuild from scratch; - duplicate events are idempotent; - unknown schema fields are tolerated; - stale views are labeled and never used for command authorization.

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Order C2 - Adapter compliance probes

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Order C3 - Operator control panel

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Order C5 - Governance and tool gates
claimedCapabilities.gate: - destructive git fixture is blocked before side effects; - the denial is visible in transcript and Work Receipt; - remediation offers a safe alternative; - same-UID or unmanaged bodies are not overclaimed as contained.

claimedCapabilities.name: Work Order C8 - Setup and doctor remediation
claimedCapabilities.gate: - one default install path; - one doctor repair path per detected issue when possible; - no stale npm instructions; - users can see what is local, what syncs, and what is disabled.
